base.name: Lies of P
base.requirements: Earn every other base-game trophy; the platinum unlocks when the final missing base trophy is awarded.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Real boy : They all lived happily ever after
base.requirements: At the ending choice, give Geppetto your heart; this ends the story without the Nameless Puppet fight.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Free from the puppet string
base.requirements: Refuse Geppetto and defeat the Nameless Puppet while lacking the Humanity route needed for Rise of P (or leave Sophia alive).
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Rise of P
base.requirements: Accumulate high Humanity, grant Sophia peace, refuse Geppetto, then defeat the Nameless Puppet.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: The First Puppet
base.requirements: Defeat the Nameless Puppet in the Under the Abyss finale after refusing Geppetto.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Strongest Normal Weapon
base.requirements: Fully upgrade any normal weapon to its maximum level at Hotel Krat using Weapon Assembly materials.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Strongest Special Weapon
base.requirements: Fully upgrade a special boss-Ergo weapon to its maximum level with Dark Moon Moonstone of the Covenant.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Strongest Legion Arm
base.requirements: Upgrade one Legion Arm to its maximum enhancement level at the Venigni machine.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Extreme Potential
base.requirements: Unlock every P-Organ phase by spending Quartz at Geppetto's chair in Hotel Krat.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Pianist of Krat
base.requirements: After an ending, interact with Hotel Krat's piano and play it; the perfect-performance prompt awards this trophy.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Legion Arm Collector
base.requirements: Craft all eight base-game Legion Arms at Venigni's machine, including the three requiring hidden Cryptic Vessel discoveries.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Special Weapon Collector
base.requirements: Exchange every base-game rare Ergo with Alidoro/Hugo for each special weapon; do not consume the Ergo first.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Normal Weapon Collector
base.requirements: Acquire every base-game normal weapon, including all shop and found blades, handles, blunt weapons, and the two starting weapons.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Golden Melody
base.requirements: Collect and listen to every base-game record (16 total) at Hotel Krat; NG+ is required for Golden Records and the alternate Eugénie record, and missable NPC/shop records must be secured before their cutoffs.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Learning about Emotions
base.requirements: Learn every base-game gesture from notes, books, NPC quests, and story events; perform the required interactions before their quest cutoffs.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Veteran Explorer
base.requirements: Open every base-game Cryptic Vessel and finish each cipher's clue at its marked location, collecting the resulting rewards.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: End of Riddles
base.requirements: Answer all five Arlecchino telephone riddles correctly and open every Trinity Sanctum with the keys obtained in chapter order.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: First Lie
base.requirements: Choose Lie at the Hotel Krat entrance portrait prompt after the opening, rather than answering Truth.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Stargazer’s Guide
base.requirements: Activate every base-game Stargazer, including those in optional side areas, so each location registers as discovered.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Exploring Possibilities
base.requirements: Use Venigni's machine to assemble a weapon once, combining a blade and handle with compatible slots.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: The Ultimate Defense Technique
base.requirements: Destroy an enemy's weapon with repeated perfect guards until the weapon breaks and the trophy notification appears.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Fatal Blow
base.requirements: Stagger an enemy, then stand in the indicated position and perform a Fatal Attack on its exposed core.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: The Bastards and the Sweepers
base.requirements: Defeat one human Stalker of the Bastard or Sweeper faction during the early Krat route.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Parade Master
base.requirements: Defeat the Parade Master boss at Krat Central Station.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Scrapped Watchman
base.requirements: Defeat the Scrapped Watchman at Krat City Hall.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: King’s Flame
base.requirements: Defeat King’s Flame, Fuoco, at the Venigni Works furnace.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Fallen Archbishop
base.requirements: Defeat the Fallen Archbishop Andreus in St. Frangelico Cathedral.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: The Delayed Match
base.requirements: Defeat the Eldest of the Black Rabbit Brotherhood in Malum District.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: King of Puppets
base.requirements: Defeat Romeo, King of Puppets, in Estella Opera House.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: The Champion of Evolution
base.requirements: Defeat Champion Victor at the Grand Exhibition.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Puppet-Devouring Green Monster
base.requirements: Defeat the Puppet-Devouring Green Monster in the Barren Swamp.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Corrupted Parade Master
base.requirements: Defeat the Corrupted Parade Master during the Krat Central Station Redux route.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Revenge of Black
base.requirements: Defeat Laxasia the Complete at the Isle of Alchemists.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: The Complete One
base.requirements: Defeat Simon Manus, Awakened God, in Arche Abbey after the Laxasia encounter.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: The Awakened God
base.requirements: Defeat Simon Manus, Awakened God, at the end of Arche Abbey; the boss victory awards this trophy.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: Bear Gold Coin Fruit
base.requirements: Harvest a Gold Coin Fruit from the Gold Coin Tree after awakening it in Chapter 4.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: From Across the Rift
base.requirements: Kill one Dimensional Butterfly and collect the dimensional material it drops.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: The Story of the Prince
base.requirements: Complete Venigni's Chapter 3 quest: rescue him, exhaust his dialogue, and return after the required boss/event for his final reward.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: The Story of the Refined Old Lady
base.requirements: Find the sick woman in Elysion Boulevard, return the matching Broken Baby Puppet, and claim her reward before leaving the chapter.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: The Story of the One Who Dreamed
base.requirements: Complete the Weeping Woman's side quest by giving her the correct puppet and speaking to her again before the area advances.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: The Story of One Father
base.requirements: Finish Geppetto's story through the final choice: refuse his heart request for the Nameless Puppet route; giving it ends this branch.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: The Story of a Stranger Girl
base.requirements: Complete Eugenie's quest and choose the correct Alidoro identity answer, then deliver the resulting record/reward before the finale.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

base.name: The Story of the Blue Butterfly
base.requirements: Complete Sophia's final storyline by reaching her room, choosing to give her peace, and continuing to the ending branch before the point of no return.
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF pp. 11-28

dlc.name: Rose's Memory
dlc.requirements: Defeat the Blood Artist and reach the Overture ending.
sources: powerpyx_overture

dlc.name: Enduring Resolve
dlc.requirements: After defeating the Blood Artist, use the Secret Room Key in the Rose Garden and listen to the Legend's last recording.
sources: powerpyx_overture

dlc.name: True Combat Gear Collector
dlc.requirements: Collect all 10 Overture weapons and craft both Legion Arms: Icarus and Cataclysm.
dlc.reward: Bronze trophy; 10 weapons and 2 Legion Arms
sources: powerpyx_overture

dlc.name: Beyond Limitless Potential
dlc.requirements: Apply at least one upgrade in the new Upgrade P-Organ tab.
sources: powerpyx_overture

dlc.name: Memory's Melody
dlc.requirements: Collect and listen to all 8 Overture records (including the 3 Gold Records available only in New Game+).
sources: powerpyx_overture

dlc.name: To Be Human
sources: powerpyx_overture

dlc.name: Tracker of Dark Secrets
dlc.requirements: Decrypt every clue in the cipher machines, complete the Tracker's quest before the Rose Garden finale, and choose "They will be, and Krat will be saved".
sources: powerpyx_overture

dlc.name: Puppeteer of Death
dlc.requirements: Defeat Markiona, the Puppeteer of Death.
sources: powerpyx_overture

dlc.name: Anguished Guardian
dlc.requirements: Defeat the Anguished Guardian of the Ruins.
sources: powerpyx_overture

dlc.name: Blood Artist
sources: powerpyx_overture

dlc.name: Honor and Revenge
dlc.requirements: Defeat the Leader of the Bastards and the Leader of the Sweepers.
sources: powerpyx_overture

overture_sections.name: Overture access: Star's Chrysalis and Path of Pilgrim
checklist: After defeating Corrupted Parade Master in base Chapter 9, use the Star's Chrysalis at the Path of Pilgrim to enter Overture.

overture_sections.name: Overture: Forgotten Time
checklist: Clear Overture areas in route order; collect 10 weapons, 2 Legion Arms, 8 records, 8 gestures, and decrypt every cipher.

Complete every NPC quest and defeat Tyrannical Predator, Markiona, Veronique, Two-faced Overseer, Premetamorphic Green Hunter, Anguished Guardian, Lumacchio, Arlecchino, the Leaders of the Bastards and Sweepers, and Blood Artist before the Rose Garden finale.
At Rose Garden Entrance, activate the Stargazer and make a save before the Rose Garden Point of No Return.

overture_sections.name: Rose Garden Entrance PNR and post-DLC cleanup
checklist: Before entering the Rose Garden Point of No Return, finish Tracker clues and all missable collectibles; choose the required Tracker dialogue.
Defeat Blood Artist, return through Eventide Hotel Krat, listen to the Legend's recording, and collect the ending weapon and record.

chapters.name: Krat Central Station
checklist: Activate the Stargazer and track lie/truth choices.
Defeat Parade Master; reserve his Ergo and complete all station NPC actions before leaving.

chapters.name: Krat City Hall and Elysion Boulevard
checklist: Complete the Weeping Woman, merchant, and riddle steps.
Defeat Scrapped Watchman; reserve his Ergo and finish Hotel Krat rewards.

chapters.name: Venigni Works
checklist: Rescue Venigni and obtain Puppet String; complete factory records and sanctum.
Defeat King's Flame, Fuoco; reserve his Ergo for its weapon trade.

chapters.name: St. Frangelico Cathedral
checklist: Complete Sister Cecile's request, record, and Pray gesture before Archbishop Andreus.
Open the Cathedral Trinity Sanctum and reserve Andreus's Ergo.

chapters.name: Malum District
checklist: Complete Red Fox, Black Cat, Polendina, supply-box, and Trinity Sanctum actions.
Collect the Bone-Cutting Sawblade before leaving and defeat the Eldest Brotherhood.

chapters.name: Rosa Isabelle Street and Estella Opera House
checklist: Resolve Julian and the baby-puppet requests with their required answers.
Complete Opera records and sanctum; defeat Romeo and finish Antonia's Hotel actions.

chapters.name: Grand Exhibition
checklist: Collect Exhibition records, supply box, riddle, sanctum, and cryptic-vessel steps.
Defeat Champion Victor and reserve his Ergo for Frozen Feast.

chapters.name: Barren Swamp
checklist: Complete Broken Puppet training, swamp records, and merchant actions.
Defeat Green Monster and reserve its Ergo; finish the Swamp Trinity Sanctum.

chapters.name: Krat Central Station Redux
checklist: Complete Collapsed Krat, Test Subject 326, Eugenie, and Alidoro identity actions.
Defeat Corrupted Parade Master, then unlock Overture at the Stargazer before entering Relic.

chapters.name: Relic of Trismegistus
checklist: Complete Brotherhood, Hugo, and remaining sanctum and cryptic-vessel actions.
Defeat the Relic boss and reserve its Ergo before proceeding to the Isle.

chapters.name: Isle of the Alchemists and Arche Abbey
checklist: Finish Arche Abbey records, weapons, arms, letters, and final sanctum actions.
Cloud-save before Sophia/Gepetto choices; defeat Simon and Nameless Puppet, then complete post-DLC Hotel cleanup.

endings.name: Rise of P
endings.branch: Build high Humanity through lie/compassion choices; the heart-pounding/white-hair signal confirms sufficient Humanity. Give Sophia peace, refuse Geppetto's request, then defeat the Nameless Puppet.
endings.cloud_save: Back up before Sophia; keep the save through the Geppetto/Nameless Puppet sequence and reload only after post-ending cleanup
endings.post_ending: Return to Hotel Krat for post-ending letters and piano interaction before starting NG+
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF p. 10

endings.name: Free from the Puppet String
endings.branch: Have insufficient Rise of P Humanity and/or let Sophia live, refuse Geppetto's request, then defeat the Nameless Puppet.
prerequisites: Insufficient Rise of P Humanity and/or let Sophia live
endings.cloud_save: Reload the pre-Sophia cloud save after completing post-ending letters and piano interaction
endings.post_ending: Return to Hotel Krat for post-ending letters and piano interaction before starting NG+
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF p. 10

endings.name: Real Boy: They All Lived Happily Ever After
endings.branch: Give your heart to Geppetto when requested; this ends the route without the Nameless Puppet fight.
endings.final_boss: Do not refuse Geppetto; Nameless Puppet is not fought
endings.cloud_save: Back up before Geppetto's request so the refusal/Nameless Puppet branches remain available
endings.post_ending: Return to Hotel Krat for post-ending letters and piano interaction before starting NG+
sources: PSNProfiles Lies of P Trophy Guide PDF p. 10

endings.name: Blood Artist / Rose's Memory outcome
endings.branch: Defeat Blood Artist to earn the Rose's Memory outcome; this is the verified Overture finale outcome.
endings.cloud_save: At Rose Garden Entrance, before the Point of No Return, complete missable cleanup first
sources: powerpyx_overture
endings.post_ending: Return to Eventide Hotel Krat for post-DLC cleanup.

endings.name: Lea / Legend recording outcome
endings.branch: Complete Lea's Overture route and listen to the Legend's last recording in the post-DLC Hotel Krat cleanup.
endings.cloud_save: Before the Rose Garden Point of No Return, finish Lea's route and all missable Overture tasks
sources: powerpyx_overture
requirements: Listen to the Legend's last recording
endings.post_ending: Return through Eventide Hotel Krat and listen to the Legend's recording.
